newsitem.title: USA: Northwest to apply cargo/express fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: Northwest to apply cargo/express fuel surcharge.

text.p: Northwest Airlines said it will beginning applying fuel surcharges on all cargo and express shipments system-wide.

Cargo marketing director Vince Puccia said the surcharge takes effect on Thursday for customers paying with cash, credit card or cheque and November 15 for all other customers. Puccia listed the surcharges as $0.025 cents per pound for domestic shipments, $0.11/kilogram for transatlantic shipments, $0.16/kg for transpacific shipments and $0.10 cents/kg for shipments within Asia. A $1 per piece surcharge will be applied to the company's same-day VIP domestic product, he said.
"We may have to adjust the surcharge when aviation fuel prices change and will eliminate it when fuel prices return to normal levels," said Puccia.
